##### Project general facts

Luma22 is an unparalleled residential development by TownX. This exceptional building offers a collection of exquisite, affordable upscale apartments designed for a community of busy professionals and families. Vibrant, light-filled spaces offer picturesque views of centrally located private gardens, creating an ideal living space where convenience, beauty, and state-of-the-art amenities come together in perfect harmony.

Residents enjoy a range of convenient, chic amenities designed to enhance daily living. Refresh in cool swimming pools, invigorate in spotless gyms with separate men's and women's facilities, or stroll through private central gardens with a dedicated children's play area. Concierge services are always available to ensure enjoyment and peace of mind. The attention to detail offers thoughtful amenities, from modern bathrooms with built-in shelving and roomy drawers to polished tile surrounding the shower.

Every apartment at Luma22 features SICILIA luxury modular kitchens with QUARTZ (TECHNESTONE) countertops, SIEMENS appliances, LEGRAND electrical fittings, and SAMSUNG AC units with smart thermostat control. Form and function blend seamlessly in this modern building, where quality furnishings and practical amenities exceed expectations. The interior design matches the exterior splendour, with plenty of finishing touches designed to add to your enjoyment, making every home a place you truly love. 

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Jumeirah Village Circle, one of Dubai's fastest expanding neighborhoods, this exceptional location offers a master community designed for easy highway access to work, schools, malls, entertainment, and sports. Frequent travellers can connect to world-class transportation hubs of Al Maktoum and Dubai International Airport, while the community features numerous parks, schools, and shopping destinations.

The location is distinguished by its abundance of green spaces and family-friendly amenities. Multiple parks, playgrounds, and educational institutions including JSS International School and nursery facilities are within easy reach. The community's thoughtful planning ensures residents enjoy a balanced lifestyle with everything they need close at hand.

For those seeking a residence that embodies community living, green spaces, and a prime Dubai address, Jumeirah Village Circle delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of convenience, amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can discover new beginnings.
